Target reported EBITDA 90 EUR + signed lease adjustment 10 = comparable EBITDA 100 EUR.
Alpha: reported operating value 700 EUR + lease liability adjustment 50 = comparable EV 750 EUR.
Alpha reported EBITDA 80 EUR + lease adjustment 20 = comparable EBITDA 100 EUR; EV/EBITDA 7.5x.

The independently selected multiple is 8x, a synthetic professional assumption, not the arithmetic mean or median (8.75x).
The universe, sector, markets, growth, margins, size, risk and leverage explanations are hypothetical; matching labels and sums do not establish actual comparability or IFRS 16 correctness.
